seriesTitle: Had I Not Seen the Sun

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: A film crew covers the case of an infamous killer for a documentary. Pin-yu starts to have strange visions and encounters in her new house.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: A teenage Jen-yao faces a difficult time at home and forms a friendship with a dancer in school. In the present, Pin-yu continues to see the ghostly girl.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: While on assignment at Jen-yao's old house, Pin-yu finds a photo connected to her visions. In the past, a teenage Jen-yao gets into an accident.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: As Hsiao-tung and Jen-yao grow closer, their bond deepens, sparking jealousy from someone who secretly has feelings for her.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: A nasty rumor spreads in school about Hsiao-tung and Jen-yao. As school authorities get involved, a friend takes the fall while tensions grow in class.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Jen-yao leaves home, Hsiao-tung and Yun-chen take a trip together. Yun-chen makes a life-changing choice. In the present, Ta-wei finds a shocking video.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: Jen-yao faces the ultimate betrayal when someone close frames him for crimes he did not commit, making him a wanted man.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: Wanting to support Jen-yao, Hsiao-tung attempts to get closer to Ouyang Ti. But as the night progresses, the situation takes a dangerous turn.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.summary: Seeing her hurt and in pain, Hsiao-tung's mother promises that she will get justice for her. An enraged Jen-yao decides to plot for revenge.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.summary: On the rooftop, Hsiao-tung and Jen-yao make a promise to meet in five years. On the streets of Taipei years later, Jen-yao encounters a familiar stranger.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Jen-yao starts a friendship with a blind radio DJ. At a hospital, a ghost from the past triggers Che-li.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Tien-ching and Jen-yao start spending more time together. Che-li's guilty conscience haunts him, sparking flashbacks to that night in high school.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: After the traumatic night she had, a teenage Hsiao-tung spirals into a bad state. In the present, Jen-yao finds out the truth about Tien-ching.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Big K advises Jen-yao not to get involved with Ouyang Ti and his gang. At a high school reunion, Hsiao-tung's name sparks gossip.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Tien-ching worries when Jen-yao doesn't answer his phone. Ouyang Ti looks all over town for Wei-ting but is nowhere to be found.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Tien-ching confronts some unsettling truths that shake her to the core. In a moment of impulse, Jen-yao makes a choice that changes everything.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: A familiar figure from his past turns up at Jen-yao's place. Shen Mu tells Jen-yao that she knows of his dark secrets.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: The wave of brutal murders makes it on the news. Jen-yao forms an unexpected alliance with Shen Mu.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.summary: The murders continue. Jen-yao commits one last act of violence before turning himself in.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.summary: Jen-yao gets an unexpected visit from a loved one and experiences a bittersweet moment as he faces his fate.
